## Change

Describe the case, portal pattern, calculation behavior, or documentation change.

## Evidence and Scope

- [ ] Official source URLs and report year are included where relevant.
- [ ] Entity, funding, amount-unit, and personnel scopes are stated.
- [ ] Expert inference, if any, is labelled separately from source facts.
- [ ] No personal data, private documents, or credentials are included.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
- [ ] New or changed calculation behavior has a focused test.
